text:
Which statement about petroleum is not correct?
A
It can be separated into useful substances by fractional distillation.
B
It consists mainly of hydrocarbons.
C
It is found underground in many parts of the world.
D
Its main use is for making lubricants and polishes.

options.label: A
options.text: It can be separated into useful substances by fractional distillation.

options.label: C
options.text: It is found underground in many parts of the world.

options.label: D
options.text: Its main use is for making lubricants and polishes.
